summary: Retest of the useEffect(load, []) fix propagated to HolidaysPage, LeavesAdminPage, MyLeaves, and ReportPage. Backend regression (17 tests scoped to Auth/CRUD/Leaves/Holidays/Reports) all pass. Frontend E2E: /admin/holidays loads, create + delete + nav-away-and-back works with zero console errors. /admin/leaves loads, admin 'Setujui' updates status to 'Disetujui' via PUT /api/leaves/{id}/decision. /app/leaves loads for employee, 'Ajukan' dialog submits leave and it appears with 'Menunggu' badge. /admin/weekly & /admin/monthly load, 'Muat' fetches report. /admin/locations regression: still OK. No 'destroy is not a function' TypeError observed on any of the four fixed pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is consistent across all 4 files (useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])). Consider adding an ESLint rule (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps + custom lint) to prevent recurrence of passing Promise-returning functions as effect callbacks.
load() functions have no error handling (.catch). If API fails (e.g., 401 after token expiry), the UI silently shows empty state. Suggest toast.error in catch, at least for admin pages.
ReportPage exportExcel/exportPdf assume `data` is non-null; if user clicks export before 'Muat', it will throw. Consider disabling export buttons until data is loaded.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Holidays, Admin Leaves, Employee Leaves, Weekly/Monthly Reports, Locations regression)

seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_UI_Holiday (deleted after test) and TEST_UI_LEAVE_REASON (annual leave for Budi Santoso, approved by admin, remains in DB as approved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter_2 fixed LocationsPage useEffect Promise bug; iter_3 verified same pattern-fix applied to HolidaysPage, LeavesAdminPage, MyLeaves, ReportPage - all confirmed working with zero console errors. Backend endpoints /api/holidays and /api/leaves (create + list + decision) all functional. Employee 'Cuti' bottom-nav route is /app/leaves. Admin approves via 'Setujui' button which triggers PUT /api/leaves/{id}/decision.
rca of the issue: Same RCA as iter_2: useEffect(load, []) where load returns a Promise triggers 'destroy is not a function' TypeError because React expects effect callback to return undefined or a cleanup function. Fix pattern: useEffect(() => { load(); }, []). Confirmed applied and working in HolidaysPage.jsx:17, LeavesAdminPage.jsx:13, MyLeaves.jsx:19, ReportPage.jsx:38.
